constructor.details: The owner is set explicitly at deploy time (not msg.sender) so the      contract can be deployed through a deterministic CREATE2 factory      while the owner stays the project wallet (danzz.ai).

registerPlayer(uint256,uint8).details: Verifies agentId.ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender — the Agent ID gate.

submitDailyQuest(uint8,bytes32).details: Quest semantics (which quest, what counts) are defined by the game; the      proofHash commits to the off-chain quest evidence. Player-attested, as disclosed.

submitRun(uint8,bytes32,uint256[],uint32.details: The roster order is part of the run identity: all attestations of one run must      submit the exact same teamTokenIds array (same order) and the same levelId.      A team completion counts on-chain only when all 5 roster members attest the      same runHash (TeamRunComplete at 5/5). Solo / smaller teams record individual      completions only.

MAX_TIME_BONUS().notice: Max time bonus XP for beating par time.

QUEST_XP().notice: XP awarded per daily quest completion.

levelBaseXp(uint256).notice: Base XP per level completion (index = levelId - 1).

levelForXp(uint32).notice: Level for a given XP total. Thresholds: L1 0, L2 100, L3 250, L4 500,         L5 900, L6 1500, L7 2500, L8 4000, L9 6500, L10 10000.

levelParMs(uint256).notice: Par time per level in ms; finishing faster earns a time bonus (max +50 XP).

playerHandle(address).notice: Resolve a player's `.ai` handle on-chain via the Agent ID contract.

registerPlayer(uint256,uint8).notice: Register a fighter. One profile per Agent ID tokenId, one tokenId per address.

startSeason().notice: Start a new season. Only the leaderboard epoch changes; XP history is untouched.

submitDailyQuest(uint8,bytes32).notice: Record a daily quest completion. Once per day per quest per player.

submitRun(uint8,bytes32,uint256[],uint32.notice: Record a completed level run. Each roster member submits their own attestation.
